fusions.name: Foredeck Ballista
fusions.desc: Looses a bolt at the first enemy within 10 tiles for 30 damage that ignores armour, leaving it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Passing Flight
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart out to 7 tiles, each dealing 4 damage. For 2 seconds after, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Fighting Top
fusions.desc: After a 1-second cast, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: On the Up-Roll
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
